mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, thereby boosting equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the signal fails to generate a positive Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the probability of a central bank intervention to stimulate growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 over the past month signals a contraction in real output, which increases the risk of stagflation and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 104.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 235.0 with a 12-month growth rate exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, increasing the probability of a delayed rate cut or further tightening, which pressures equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.0 and 12mo growth > 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to achieve a Rank IC above 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a stable unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.5%), indicates labor market overheating, which increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200.0 and UNRATE < 5.5%, or the interaction signal fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.3%), indicates a supply-side contraction coupled with labor market weakness, increasing the risk of a recession and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 and UNRATE > 5.3%, or the joint signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
